summary: ADS-Tec Energy Public Ltd Co filed a Form 6-K reporting a private placement via subscription agreements. On May 28, 2026, it entered into an agreement with Svelland Global Trading Master Fund and Mirabella-managed accounts to issue non-transferable subscription rights for up to 5,000,000 ordinary shares at $1.00 per share; 3,000,000 shares were immediately exercised for ~$3 million gross proceeds. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. The shares are unregistered and rely on Regulation S. A registration rights agreement provides customary resale shelf rights. Outstanding shares post-deal: 75,002,051. This capital raise restructures equity without an active tender or buyback. Watch for dilution impact and stock price support at the exercise price.
